## Purpose
`/remote-servers/$id`: one remote server, with tabs for overview, workflows, push, console, deployments and settings. It also covers running diagnostics, removing the server, and Brev provisioning.

## Responsibilities
`RemoteServerDetailPage`:
- reads `remoteServersApi.get`, `providers` and `deployments`;
- `check`: "All checks passed." or "Server is <status>.";
- `remove`: "Server removed.";
- tabs from `components/remote-servers/detail/*` (OverviewTab, WorkflowsTab, SettingsTab, ServerHeader, ServerPanels), plus `Deployments`, `RemoteConsole` and `ServerForm`;
- `BackLink`.

Titled "Remote Server — Agentic AI Design Patterns".

## Key elements
`RemoteServerDetailPage`.

## Control flow
React Query, with tabs.

## Data, state and side effects
Server changes and remote actions.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Backend:** `/api/remote-servers/*`.

## Error handling and edge cases
- A tab this server does not have (from an old link) falls back to the overview.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **Provisioning rewrites the host, key and diagnostics,** so the page reloads once it ends.
- **A run may have logged the Brev CLI out, or back in,** so the account status is refreshed.
- **Workflows, Push, Console and Settings all change the server,** so they invalidate its queries.
